## Problem

Describe the observed behavior and expected behavior.

## Reproduction

Include the release, Python version, command, and a minimal synthetic fixture.
Use Acme Widgets and `.example` domains. Do not paste credentials, private audit
data, personal information, or absolute machine paths. For security issues,
follow SECURITY.md instead of disclosing details here.

## Output

Paste sanitized error output and describe how often it happens.

## Checks

- [ ] I used local fixtures and made no paid calls to reproduce this issue.
- [ ] I removed private information from the report.
